declarations.name: VeraInput
declarations.description: Wraps the user's own <input> (the form participant: autofill, validity, reset and disabled stay the platform's), with optional prefix and suffix parts of the user's. With no <input> inside it renders one, server-side too, from its name, type, value, placeholder and autocomplete, read once. Options add a clear button that keeps the input's undo history, a password reveal, a caps-lock hint (shown and announced), and a loading mark with aria-busy on the input. It never labels: put it in a <label> or a <vera-field>.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows a clear button while the input has a value it may clear (not disabled or read-only, and not while a composite's list is open: aria-expanded="true"). The button is out of the tab order; Escape clears a type="search" input, and select-all then Delete clears any. Observed.

attributes.name: clear-label
attributes.description: The clear button's accessible name. Default "Clear". Observed.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Sets aria-busy="true" on the input and shows the aria-hidden loading mark. Observed.

attributes.name: reveal
attributes.description: On a type="password" input: a show/hide button after it (aria-pressed), in the tab order. The input is a password again on submit, on pagehide and when reveal is removed, so form history, the save-password prompt and the back-forward cache never keep it as text. Observed.

attributes.name: reveal-label
attributes.description: The reveal button's accessible name. Default "Show password". Observed.

attributes.name: caps-lock-hint
attributes.description: Shows the caps-lock part while Caps Lock is on in the input, and announces it once per focus. Observed.

attributes.name: caps-lock-message
attributes.description: What the hint shows and says. Default "Caps Lock is on". Observed.

attributes.name: scale
attributes.description: sm, md or lg: the box's font size, which the input and its parts follow, md the page's and sm and lg around it; none is the page's too (never size, which <input size> already means).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Copied to the default input once, at render; not observed.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Copied to the default input once, at render; not observed.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Copied to the default input once, at render; not observed.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Copied to the default input once, at render; not observed.

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: Copied to the default input once, at render; not observed.

cssParts.name: input
cssParts.description: The default input, rendered only when the user wrote none.

cssParts.name: prefix
cssParts.description: The user's own content before the input.

cssParts.name: suffix
cssParts.description: The user's own content after the input.

cssParts.name: clear
cssParts.description: The clear button, with clearable; hidden while there is nothing to clear.

cssParts.name: loading
cssParts.description: The loading mark, with loading; aria-hidden (aria-busy on the input carries it).

cssParts.name: reveal
cssParts.description: The show/hide button, with reveal on a password input.

cssParts.name: caps-lock
cssParts.description: The caps-lock hint, with caps-lock-hint; hidden while Caps Lock is off.
